newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy draft law will free trade in gold bullion.
newsitem.headline: Italy draft law will free trade in gold bullion.

text.p: The Italian government drafted a law on Friday to abolish the state's monopoly on gold bullion, a cabinet statement said.

It said the draft, which must now go to parliament, included provisions to exempt gold bullion operations from Value Added Tax. Transactions would be liable to capital gains tax and operators would have to declare transactions in gold of 20 million lire or more.
The statement, issued after the cabinet met to approve the draft, said the new provisions would bring Italian rules on gold trading into line with European Union directives on free commerce.
"The measure defines which professionals can operation in the sector, including banks, which must meet specific requirements of professionalism, honourability and reliability," the statement said.
Under existing provisions, all trade in gold bullion has to be conducted through the Bank of Italy or its appointed agents.
